breadth_audit.monday_note: Monday run opening 2026-W29. Genuinely NEW structural signals today: (1) MCP's 2026-07-28 Release Candidate — stateless core + OAuth 2.1 makes MCP production-ready, the day's anchor; (2) Snowflake Cortex Sense runtime knowledge layer (86% vs 24%) pushing retrieval past vector-only RAG; (3) Microsoft's $2.5B Frontier Company crystallizing the 'deployment, not models' implementation-revenue thesis; (4) a coding-agent trust backlash (Apple v OpenAI, Grok CLI whole-repo upload, Claude Code 33k tokens) as the loudest dev sentiment; (5) Meta Muse Spark + DeepSeek V4 GA turning frontier competition into an agentic-coding price war. Most launch-week topics keep fading via slow-EMA smoothing.
breadth_audit.linkedin_stub_note: LinkedIn collector was a skip-stub again (two Chrome browsers connected in a non-interactive cron run — auto-select forbidden; recurrence 07-05/10/11/12/13). LinkedIn-driven topics (governance, RAG discourse) run slightly light on raw_today as a collection artifact, not structural decline; EMA damps it and stages held.
breadth_audit.papers_egress_note: arXiv RSS/listing egress was cache-lagged this run; the papers batch leads with the freshest reachable 09-10 Jul items filled from the early-July window, so paper-driven raw counts (agent-memory, evaluation-gap, automated-ai-research, tool-use-standards) are conservative.

config_snapshot._purpose: exact tuning constants in effect this run, for reproducibility

thresholds._comment: Lowered 2026-06-03 from 15/20 alongside BREADTH_PLAN actor-attribution. Removing publishers + contrast co-mentions shrinks every topic's org set, so the old 15/20 floor (set against the inflated distribution) would almost never fire. After the first corrected radar run, read breadth_audit.median_breadth_30d and re-tune: high_breadth_7d ~= top-third of the NEW distribution, very_high ~= top-quartile.
